_comment: A speed_aura that boosts move speed for every ally within a 2.5-unit radius (uncapped, not just the nearest), reapplying every 30 ticks: 1.3x speed plus 0.05 per level. The caster itself can never be targeted; you run the field, you do not ride it. Cost is charged per ally who newly enters range, not per tick of holding them. All values placeholder.
name: FlyYouFools
